name: netsis
title: Netsis (Logo Netsis 3 Standard / Enterprise)
summary: Netsis on SQL Server. Columns are plain codes and tables join on code values (CARI_KOD, STOK_KODU), not on numeric IDs. Invoice and dispatch headers share TBLFATUIRS; their lines are stock movements in TBLSTHAR.
rules: STHAR_GCKOD: 'G' = in (giriş), 'C' = out (çıkış). Stock = SUM of G minus SUM of C.
FTIRSIP (and STHAR_FTIRSIP): 1 sales invoice, 2 purchase invoice, 3 sales dispatch, 4 purchase dispatch, 6 customer order, 7 vendor order, 8/9 warehouse transfer in/out.
On sales and order lines the account (cari) code is in STHAR_ACIKLAMA; STHAR_CARIKOD is the delivery party.
Join invoice lines to headers on TBLSTHAR.FISNO = TBLFATUIRS.FATIRS_NO AND STHAR_FTIRSIP = FTIRSIP (likely).
Some installs store Turkish text in a legacy encoding and wrap it in dbo.TRK(); check one row before trusting text comparisons.
Use WITH (NOLOCK) on large movement tables so the agent never blocks the ERP.

tables.name: TBLCAHAR
tables.title: Account ledger (cari hareket)
columns: A opening, B invoice, C return, D cash, E/F note, G/H cheque, K debit/credit note (likely)

tables.name: TBLSTHAR
tables.title: Stock movements (stok hareket) — also invoice and dispatch lines
columns: Movement type (H dispatch, I closed invoice, J open invoice, L return)
joins: TBLFATUIRS ON FISNO = FATIRS_NO AND STHAR_FTIRSIP = FTIRSIP

tables.name: TBLSTOKPH
tables.title: Stock balances per item and warehouse (maintained by trigger)

queries.title: Stock on hand per warehouse for one item
queries.sql: SELECT A.STOK_KODU, B.STOK_ADI, A.DEPO_KODU, A.TOP_GIRIS_MIK - A.TOP_CIKIS_MIK AS BAKIYE FROM TBLSTOKPH A WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN TBLSTSABIT B ON A.STOK_KODU = B.STOK_KODU WHERE A.STOK_KODU = 'ITEM-CODE'

queries.title: Open balance of one account
queries.sql: SELECT C.CARI_KOD, C.CARI_ISIM, SUM(H.BORC - H.ALACAK) AS BAKIYE FROM TBLCAHAR H WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN TBLCASABIT C ON C.CARI_KOD = H.CARI_KOD WHERE H.CARI_KOD = 'ACCOUNT-CODE' GROUP BY C.CARI_KOD, C.CARI_ISIM

queries.title: Sales invoices, last 30 days
queries.sql: SELECT FATIRS_NO, TARIH, CARI_KODU, GENELTOPLAM FROM TBLFATUIRS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE FTIRSIP = '1' AND TARIH >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE())
